description: Analyze the competitive landscape for auto insurance telematics across the top 50 US metropolitan areas, focusing on market structure, pricing models, and competitive positioning

end_product: comparison table with 8+ competitors and market share estimates, supported by trend analysis of OEM-embedded vs aftermarket adoption
